adjudicated.jp: 放送部の合宿だった。
adjudicated.en: It was the Broadcast Club Training Camp.
adjudicated.assessment: The English preserves the source's propositional content and local pragmatic function without a material addition, omission, or role reversal.

adjudicated.jp: 俺たち一年生が進級し、幸せな三年生が引退して。
adjudicated.en:
Among us the freshmen are being promoted,
while the happy third years are retiring.
comments: Hum. Japan school year starts in Spring, and there isn't much to say that Gunjou is any different. Taichi is halfway through second year by the Camp scene, so I can't make this make much sense outside of really blatant trolling. Unless he's actually a delayed First Year, it's the norm at Gunjou. Same for the third years: Misato (and Youko FWIW) should be dropping club to focus on graduation and university entrance exams. There's never been mention of there ever having been any member in the Broadcast Club outside of the eight except for Miyuki. See CCC3004. -GHS
adjudicated.assessment: The source narrates the first-years advancing a grade and the third-years retiring as linked completed transitions. "Among us the freshmen are being promoted" is ungrammatical and changes the sequence to present progressive actions.
adjudicated.remedy: Use "We first-years moved up a grade, and the happy third-years retired.".

highlights.text:
Among us the freshmen are being promoted,
while the happy third years are retiring.

adjudicated.jp: 彼女は……どうせ呼べばすぐにやってくる。
adjudicated.en: Her... after all, she'll turn up quick if called.
adjudicated.assessment: The source's topic is "she": if called, she will come right away anyway. "Her" uses the object form as the subject, and "turn up quick" is grammatically nonstandard here.
adjudicated.remedy: Use "She... would come right away if we called her, anyway.".

highlights.text: Her... after all, she'll turn up quick if called.

adjudicated.jp: ７人集めるのに。
adjudicated.en: For this gathering of seven,
adjudicated.assessment: The English preserves the source's propositional content and local pragmatic function without a material addition, omission, or role reversal.

adjudicated.jp: 支払った代価は安くない。
adjudicated.en: there was no cheap price to pay.
adjudicated.assessment: The source says the price paid to gather seven people was not small. "There was no cheap price to pay" is an unnatural negative construction that fails to state clearly that a steep price was actually paid.
adjudicated.remedy: Use "the price we paid was not small.".

highlights.text: there was no cheap price to pay.

adjudicated.jp: そりゃもう大騒ぎさ。
adjudicated.en: That is, it was already an uproar.
adjudicated.assessment: そりゃもう emphatically introduces the scale of the commotion. "That is, it was already" misreads the idiomatic discourse phrase as explanatory and temporal wording.
adjudicated.remedy: Use "It caused one hell of a commotion.".

highlights.text: That is, it was already an uproar.

adjudicated.jp: 学院には内緒のオチャメ。
adjudicated.en: a mischief kept away from the Institute.
adjudicated.assessment: The source calls it a bit of mischief kept secret from the academy. "A mischief kept away from the Institute" changes secrecy into physical separation and uses an unnatural count noun.
adjudicated.remedy: Use "a little mischief kept secret from the academy.".

highlights.text: a mischief kept away from the Institute.

adjudicated.jp: 公になれば、ちょっとした騒ぎになる。
adjudicated.en:
If this was turned public, it
would become quite the uproar.
adjudicated.assessment: The source says that if it became public, it would cause a minor commotion. "If this was turned public" is ungrammatical and imposes an external passive agent not present in the source.
adjudicated.remedy: Use "If it became public, it would cause a bit of a commotion.".

adjudicated.jp: そうして、合宿が終わり。
adjudicated.en: Finally, the Training Camp is ending.
adjudicated.assessment: The source says "and so the training camp ended." "Is ending" changes the completed event to an ongoing one, and "Finally" adds a culmination marker not present in the sentence.
adjudicated.remedy: Use "And so the training camp ended.".

highlights.text: Finally, the Training Camp is ending.

adjudicated.jp: 七人は帰路に着いた。
adjudicated.en: Seven people reached the way of return.
adjudicated.assessment: 帰路に着いた means the seven set out on the journey home. "Reached the way of return" is an unidiomatic literal construction and can imply that they arrived at a road rather than departed.
adjudicated.remedy: Use "The seven of us set out for home.".

highlights.text: Seven people reached the way of return.

adjudicated.jp: 人類は滅亡していた。
adjudicated.en: Mankind had fallen.
comments: Literally it's closer to extinction, but it follows in the sense of downfall, of a clan a family etc. - the sense is pretty much that of the actual Fall of Mankind. Curiously, 人類は滅亡しました (jinrui wa metsubou shimsashita) googles to Jintai. No autocorrections or "did you mean", googl that with quotes around it and it literally googles to Jintai, big banner on the right about the series included. -GHS
adjudicated.assessment: 滅亡していた states that humanity had become extinct. "Had fallen" can mean defeat or decline and does not communicate extinction.
